description: The commonest Kinkerstraat front (1883-1897: 1-29, 31-49, 65-87, 86-110, 206-234, 244-332): plain red-brown brick, 3 axes on ~6 m (2 on narrow pands), flat-headed sash windows under brick lintels, white frames, heavy cream stucco cornice with consoles; crowns: one pediment dormer with a finial, none, a round-topped dormer; shop ground

pediment-dormer.note: one pedimented dormer with a zinc finial per house (31-49 pands 2-9, 65-87 pands 4-10) (#98: white painted bodies, dormerBody stone; a trim-slot body exported as a frame sunk in the low front attic and failed the opening-outside audit)

arched-dormer.note: Kinkerstraat 22 and 24 (2-30 pands 4-5, strip 2024-12-11): one white dormer per house under a round hood (a fan in the tympanum), about 2.1 m wide with the hood and 1 m high over the frame; drawn as dormerStyle arched in the stone colour (the fan is not drawn)

roof.evidence: strips 2024-11-29/2024-12-11: over the cornice only the dormers stand against the sky, no roof face shows; PDOK orthophoto 2024: flat roofs (terraces, bitumen) behind a ~1 m front slope on Kinkerstraat 1A-5, 4-20, 55-63; a low attic behind the cornice instead of the 70 degree attic storey

rhythm.identicalBays: upper storeys: equal axes, no balconies
rhythm.groundFloor: shop per house, residential door beside it
rhythm.roofline: heavy cream cornice with consoles; one pediment dormer
schemaLimits: brick flat-arch lintels over the windows are not drawn

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2024-12-11 pands 3-9: identical 3-axis plain fronts with pediment dormers; detect-house-types kinker-31-49 type A (7 modules)
strip.jpg 2024-12-11 pands 1, 4, 5 (zoom): plain brick; 22-24 have segmental heads and 5 storeys

schemaLimits: round-topped dormers with a shell hood (22-24) are drawn as pediment dormers: the pointed dormer read far too tall on the first sheet
